The '''Astorian Republic''' is a defunct republic named in the source list of defunct nations.

The relationship between this republic and later [[Astoria]] is not yet fixed. Existing Astoria drafts identify the nineteenth- and twentieth-century state as a stratocratic military power, but the source list separately records an Astorian Republic with unknown formation and dissolution dates.

== Canon Limits ==

This bridge page should be used only to track a possible earlier or alternative Astorian political phase. It does not yet establish a capital, constitution, borders, leaders, collapse date, or direct legal succession into the later military state.
